ops.en: lazy or avoiding activity and effort

ops.cn: （医学）进展缓慢的；惰性的；症状较轻的

ops.meaning_cn: 没有资格获得/参加某事

ops.en: lacking skill, ability, judgment, or suitability; clumsy or incompetent
ops.cn: 无能的；笨拙的；不称职的；不合适的

ops.en: not moving, not active, or lacking the power to move or respond
ops.cn: 不动的；不活跃的；惰性的

ops.en: figurative: sluggish, passive, or lacking energy
ops.cn: （比喻）迟钝的；消极的；缺乏活力的

ops.en: chemically inactive or having very low reactivity

ops.en: to be present in or spread through a place in large, harmful, or unwanted numbers
ops.cn: 大量侵扰、滋生于某地；成灾

ops.en: for parasites or pests to live on or in a host in harmful or unwanted numbers
ops.cn: （寄生虫或害虫）大量寄生于宿主

ops.en: to fill something with air or gas so that it expands
ops.cn: 给……充气；使膨胀

ops.cn: 夸大；抬高数字、价值或重要性

ops.cn: 创新者；引入新思想、方法、产品或技术的人或组织

ops.cn: 设法悄悄进入；逐渐取得位置或影响

ops.en: lacking flavor or taste; figuratively dull, bland, or uninteresting
ops.cn: 淡而无味的；乏味的；无趣的

ops.cn: 逐渐灌输思想、态度、价值观、情感或习惯

ops.value: Literal drop-by-drop instillation is historical/technical relative to the dominant figurative learner use.

ops.en: deliberately disobedient or unwilling to submit to legitimate authority or a superior
ops.cn: 不服从命令的；违抗上级的

ops.en: narrow-minded, inward-looking, or isolated from outside people, ideas, or influences
ops.cn: 思想狭隘的；闭塞内向的；与外界隔绝的

ops.en: relating to, characteristic of, or situated on an island
ops.cn: 岛屿的；位于岛上的

ops.cn: 孤立封闭的；私密到仿佛与外界隔绝的

ops.cn: 嘲笑；讥讽；以轻蔑言语或笑声侮辱
